title: Soft gate rubric
description: The Architect-owned rubric the scored llm_judge mode of ADR-MDL-0004 gives the evaluator, separate from the generic review-verdict contract. It names the four soft dimensions spec_coherence, plant_idiomaticity, test_depth and traceability_quality, each with up to 32 deterministic criteria the evaluator must observe and cite, and fixes the meaning of every integer score level 0 to 4. Aggregation is all-dimensions: each dimension is compared independently with its minimum in thresholds.schema.json, and no average, confidence or mutation result substitutes for a low dimension. Level 0 means a demonstrated contradiction; a missing observation is an evidence error, never a zero. The canonical instance is law/policy/soft-gate-rubric.json, serialized under DEVAI-CANONICAL-JSON-V1, and soft-gate evidence binds its digest as rubric_sha256.

spec_coherence: Resolve effective law and exact declared scope against the frozen candidate.
Show schema/contract/generated identities and refusal behavior remain coherent.
Cite concrete contradictions or their absence from checked artifacts.
plant_idiomaticity: Use established typed operations and approved CLI/recipe boundaries.
Keep package ownership, effects, configuration and deterministic behavior idiomatic to this plant.
Cite the relevant existing seams and any divergence.
test_depth: Check meaningful assertions and adversarial failures for the changed obligations.
Preserve existing cases/assertions and distinguish measured behavior from mocks or source-only evidence.
Cite behavior coverage, counterexamples and unresolved observation gaps.
traceability_quality: Resolve actual source-comment invariant annotations to justified effective setpoints.
Verify discovered population, lifecycle and executable assertion count/digest bindings.
Cite precise authority, test and source identities; do not accept dummy IDs or broad semantic aliases.

score_levels.0: A demonstrated contradiction of a declared obligation.
score_levels.1: Multiple major criteria fail with concrete citations.
score_levels.2: A material criterion gap remains with concrete citations.
score_levels.3: Every dimension criterion is adequately observed and cited.
score_levels.4: Every criterion is adequately observed and independently corroborated through adversarial evidence.
